risks.title: Critical Cyberthreats
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K with organizational details and oversight by the Audit Committee. Strong language on incident management. Highly weighted category due to growing technology exposure.

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment
risks.score_rationale: Loss of $1,135 Bn in 2025 related to Doors business unit. Explicit mention of future impairment risk. Alarming language regarding remaining book value.

risks.title: Glass Reinforcement Divestiture Risks
risks.score_rationale: Major strategic divestiture (GR) impacting structure and results. Clear position in 10-K as structural change. Post-divestiture disruption risk.

risks.title: Exposure to Building Market Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Company exposed to residential and commercial real estate cycles. 2025 performance impacted by declining demand. Tight macroeconomic context.

risks.title: Restrictions on Dividends and Buybacks
risks.score_rationale: Contractual limitations in credit agreement. Explicit mention of restrictive covenants. Less critical given no current breach.

ai_positioning.summary: OC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its report. There is no indication of AI use or integration in its operations.
